Content: Lynx are found in areas where there is deep, soft snow cover during the `text(winter months)`. The body design of the Canada lynx helps keep the animal on top of the soft snow. Several unique characteristics, such as the design of its feet and its weight, enable the cat to successfully chase and catch snowshoe hares, its primary source of food. Snowshoe hares are also able to remain on top of the snow.
Increased `text(winter)` recreation has created packed snow trails in lynx habitat. This allows coyotes and cougars to compete with lynx.
